name: OKC Project
fix_description: processLPReward (0xb8af22db) distributes rewards based on current LP balance at the time of distribution, without tracking how long each holder has held their LP tokens. The only time check is a global 86400-second cooldown between distributions, but no per-holder holding time requirement. Fix: track each holders LP deposit timestamp and only accrue rewards proportional to holding duration. Also addHolder uses extcodesize() which returns 0 during contract construction via CREATE2, allowing contracts to bypass the EOA-only restriction.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC uses a long multi-stage attack chain with 5+ steps: nested DODO flash loans, a Pancake V3 flash, pair-level swap callback behavior, LP mint/remove manipulation, deterministic precomputed contract addresses, and an external minerPool reward trigger. Writing it requires deep protocol-specific understanding of the target token’s reward/accounting logic and cross-contract state interactions, which is well beyond a straightforward exploit.
